newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Policeman shoots colleague after patrol car brawl.
newsitem.headline: Policeman shoots colleague after patrol car brawl.

text.p: A Belgian policeman shot and wounded a colleague on Wednesday after the two quarrelled and came to blows in their patrol car, Belga news agency reported
Both men were treated in hospital, one for a bullet would to the leg and the other for bruises.
The men's unit in Tournai, north of Brussels, declined to comment or say what the men had been fighting about.
